_conventions.frame: an index into the part's timeline. The glb's 'full' clip shows frame f at t = f / 15 s; a track's clip shows frames first..last (last < first plays backwards) at clip.sec_per_frame (manifest.json clip_timing). A hold track (from == to) has no clip: pose hold_frame
_conventions.step: cact_anim_step (src/game/actor/block.c 221-363): mode 0 holds and offers its frame to the event channel every step; modes 1 and 2 add the delta to a clock and step one frame each time it passes `period` (the walker hands it `rate`, see walker.rate); mode 3 sets frame = from + (to - from) * delta >> 16. One past the end: end 0 follows link / link_b / link_c for continuation 0 / 1 / 2 (a self link loops), 1 ping-pongs, 2 stops on the last frame, 0xff does nothing
_conventions.event: a track whose frame reaches event.frame -- by a step, or by being started with the STARTED bit, which the walker always sets (player_walk.c 629) -- reports event.code; up to five codes a step (block.c 82-95). The walker hands each one to snd_loop_set_mode (player_walk.c 704-706): event.loop
_conventions.flags: byte 3: HOLD 0x02 a new command is taken only on the step after a landing; LAUNCH 0x04 moves state 0x0a -> 0x0b and 0x0f -> 0x10; TOUGH 0x10 a landing hurts only above 0x80000, not 0x50000 (actor_player_walk.h 96-106, player_walk.c 277, 564, 709). 0x01 and 0x08 are read by nothing decompiled; JITTER 0x20 and RANDOM_LINK 0x40 (block.c 300-318) are set by no shipped track
_conventions.states: walker states (player_walk.c 362-465). `tracks` is what the arm asks the legs for; `becomes` the state it switches to in the same step, whose rate then applies; labels are ours, from the command
_conventions.rate_ref: the state (and rate) a leg clip is timed at in x1_legs.glb: the first state of 1-8, 0, 9, 0x0a, 0x0c, 0x0f, 0x11, 0x12, 0x0e that plays it (`states`: the arms that ask for it and every track their links reach on continuations 0 and 1), at its flat-ground rate

cockpit.stepped: only by the transform (player.c 1515-1521); no decompiled tick steps it otherwise

walker.tick: player_walk_tick (player_walk.c 171-744): eighths = (frame delta + carry) >> 3 steps a call (player.c 1971-1978), one leg step each

commands.jump_fast: jump without slow, unless in state 3, 0x0d or 0x0e or on a steep slope: the ground an eighth of the heading ahead, probed from 1.0 up, higher by more than 0xae1 -> 0x0a, else 0x0f (player_walk.c 186-207); takes no turn bit
commands.jump_while_running: jump held in state 3 asks for continuation 2 (player_walk.c 275-276): on the ground and not steep the legs take track 0x37 from frames 2..5 or 0x12..0x1f, else 0x36, and the state becomes 0x0d (672-691)
commands.turn: turn_a / turn_b turn the facing by +-0x20 a step less speed * turn >> 9, on the ground only; the step then asks the legs for 0x0f (turning one way) or 0x0e, which only state 0 keeps (296-312)
commands.taking: rows are tested top to bottom. On the ground a moving state with nothing commanded drops to 0 (288-291). A command becomes the state at once while the playing track lacks HOLD and either equals the state or the legs are back on track 0; otherwise the track is finished on continuation 1 (link_b). With HOLD it is taken only on the step after a landing (273-292)

states.label: hard landing
states.command: a landing faster than 0x50000 (0x80000 on a track with flag 0x10)

walker.track_choice: a step asks for its state's track; one different from the last asked (byte_ba), or any non-zero one while the legs are back on track 0, is started forward with STARTED (627-631). In the air the legs keep their track (352). A track ending on track 0 ends the state: state 0 and snd_loop_set_mode(0x27) (718-721)

rate.speed: sqrt(vx^2 + vy^2 + vz^2) of the 16.16 velocity >> 8, x (4 - lean) with the block's +0x147 set
rate.settled_speed: on flat ground a push settles at |v| = push / 0.375 (player_move.c 270-331): rate 426 at 0xa000, 682 at 0x10000, 1024 at 0x18000

transform.request: both form keys (input 0x00800000 and 0x02000000), no ramp running, no view anchor and +0xde clear; refused with sound script 0x2a while +0x146 is set (player.c 1427-1438)

to_walker.note: the same two tracks started backward (-1)

transform.ride_height: position y moves with progress << 12 >> 16: 0 to 0x1000 world units (0.5 m) higher as a hover (player.c 1506-1513)
transform.form: row (the form the mech is) turns hover at the start of walker -> hover and back to walker only at the end of hover -> walker, so the hover's tick runs through both ramps (player.c 1442-1461, 1555-1559)

hover.note: the hover's tick steps neither block (player_hover.c has no cact_anim_step); a mech spawned or reset as a hover starts on these (player_transform.c 344-359)
hover.loop: snd_loop_set_script every step: A40 idle, A41 move, A42 brake (player_hover.c 107-172, actor_player_hover.h 59-64)

sound.source: extracted/audio/pa_sound_tables.json (maps.<Map>.table_a / table_b -> slots); lead-in and loop window: its _rules.lead_in

assembly.cockpit: aRSL entry 2, the partner: stands on the legs' model point 0 = 3DHS channel 0 of the legs' frame (player.c 1621)
assembly.weapons: aRSL entry 3, bound twice (player.c 1027-1028): model_1c4 on the cockpit skeleton's record 2, model_178 on record 4, each composed with the cockpit's placement (player_bone.c, actor_player_bone.h), then pushed back along its own forward by the recoil (player.c 1707-1730)
assembly.beacon_lights: aRSL entry 4: the cockpit's orientation, at the cockpit's model point 2 = 3DHS channel 2 (player.c 1736-1739)
assembly.pilot: aRSL entry 5: not drawn with the mech; at death launched as a ballistic round from the cockpit toward the player's camera (player.c 2258-2300, 2680)

team_uv.rule: texels of the 256-wide page added to every corner of the legs, cockpit and both weapons (player_partner.c 285-320); v is the frame clock >> 2 & 0x3f instead while the cloak pickup runs (289-293)
